blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday mourned the passing of Quirino Governor and former lawmaker Dakila Carlo “Dax” Cua who passed away at the age of 48 on Tuesday evening. Cua served as Quirino governor from 2007 to 2010, and from 2019 until his death. He was also the representative of Quirino’s lone district in the 15th, 16th, and 17th Congress, from 2010 to 2019.
